Q5217.reason: Under UCC 2-207 the catalog is an invitation, the PO is the offer, and Costco's expressly conditional acceptance is a counteroffer that Rainmaking never accepted, so there is no contract.

Q6156.reason: Under FRE 804(b)(1), the company had both the opportunity and a similar motive to cross-examine the engineer at the deposition about the falsified safety reports, so the deposition qualifies as former testimony.

Q8413.reason: In Al-Adsani v. UK (2001) the ECtHR held, by 9 votes to 8, that state immunity did not violate the right of access to court under Article 6.
